# Larchlight Digital

> Friendly, simple websites for small businesses in Hampshire, UK, run by Laura. Built for people who aren't confident with technology: no jargon, and the technical side is handled for you.

## Services
- Website design and build: up to 5 pages, two rounds of changes, tested on phone, tablet and computer, with a contact form. £99 one-off as an opening offer, after a free consultation.
- Hosting and maintenance: £9.99 a month, including the client's domain, one small update a month and a monthly visitor report.
- Domains are registered in the client's own name.
- Sites are plain HTML and CSS with no WordPress, plugins or database.
- No online shops or payments built in; sites can link to existing shops such as Etsy.

## Recent work
- [Ad Hoc Creations](https://adhoccreations.co.uk): bespoke CNC woodwork and signage
- [Flo Furniture](https://flofurnitureco.co.uk): handmade solid pine storage furniture
- Rosie Ilieva Counselling: person-centred counselling in Southampton
